name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + ui domain (uitab.c / .object2 UI menu table) + descriptive 'per_job_..._cost_table' that reflects both the index (per job id) and the data type (table). No Ghidra address residue. Live Ghidra name (src=USER_DEFINED) is byte-identical to the src declaration. The 'revive_or_promote' wording is acceptable: the sole reader is internally named fd2_render_promote_members_grid (the church-revive picker's internal 'promote_members' name) and the table is a generic per-job cost multiplier, so the name accurately reflects its use.
purpose: Per-job cost multiplier used to price the church-revive (a.k.a. 'promote_members') candidate grid: displayed price = char.bLevel * cost_table[char.bJob_id - 1], rendered as an orange 5-digit decimal next to a coin icon.
logic_summary: 30-entry signed int16 lookup table. Sole reader fd2_render_promote_members_grid (@ 0x30A47) loads element (job_id - 1) via MOVSX word ptr [EAX*0x2 + 0x5266b] (stride 2, sign-extended to int) then IMUL by the char's level to form the price passed to fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer. Index = job_id - 1 with job_id in 1..0x1A, so indices 0..25 are meaningful; indices 26..29 are 100 filler. All stored values are positive (max 3000), so sign extension never changes the result.
element_semantics: One signed int16 cost-multiplier per job id, indexed by (job_id - 1) for job_id 1..0x1A. Values: 100,150,100,100,100,100,100,100,1200,1600,1000,1000,1200,1400,1200,1600,100,1800,1200,1000,3000,1000,1000,1400,350 (indices 0..24), then 100,100,100,100,100 filler (indices 25..29). Multiplied by the character level to produce the revive gold price.
notes: Verified via disassembly at 0x00030b5a: MOVSX EAX, word ptr [EAX*0x2 + 0x5266b]; IMUL EAX,[ESP+0x10] (level). Exactly one xref to 0x5266b (DATA read from fd2_render_promote_members_grid); no writer -> const=true. Live Ghidra dataType=short[30] len=60, sym src=USER_DEFINED, name byte-identical to src. Both name and comment already correct -> no src edit and no plate change; nothing to save in Ghidra.
